title: proforma_invoice
description: Extraction schema for proforma/running account bill submissions.

invoice_number.description: Proforma or RA bill reference number

ra_bill_number.description: Running account bill number if applicable

work_order_ref.description: Work order number this bill relates to

cumulative_amount.description: Cumulative billed amount up to this RA bill

annexures_submitted.description: List of annexure names included with this submission
